description.en-US: Quit and reopen Amadeus to apply. Wallpaper is always available in the sidebar.
description.zh-CN: 完全退出并重新打开 Amadeus 后生效。你也随时可以通过侧栏的 Wallpaper 切换壁纸模式。

description.en-US: Choose whether to open the control panel first or enter wallpaper directly.
description.zh-CN: 选择启动时先打开控制台，还是直接进入壁纸模式。

description.en-US: Optional on Windows: spread the transparent wallpaper controls window across the display so the Work status button and task card can be dragged anywhere on it. Drag a control to move it; right-click it to return to the authored position. Positions are stored in the wallpaper window's local storage.
description.zh-CN: Windows 可选功能：让透明壁纸控件窗口铺满整个显示器，从而可以把 Work 状态按钮和任务卡片拖到屏幕任意位置。拖动控件即可移动，右键控件恢复默认位置。位置保存在壁纸窗口的本地存储中。
